usage: A fridge is a household appliance used to keep food and drinks fresh.
You can say “We have a new fridge at home” to talk about ownership.
“Fridge” usually refers to the large cooling appliance in the kitchen.
When talking about things inside the fridge, you can say: “I still have some fruit in the fridge.”
Fridges can have different capacities and features, and usually include both cooling and freezing sections.
